title: Creating and approving proposals
summary: Prepare a proposal for review and record client approval in the portal.
excerpts: Create a proposal from the Proposals tab inside a project. Add an overview, deliverables, fees, and estimated dates. The proposal stays in your workspace until you publish it.

Clients can review a published proposal in their portal, approve it, or request changes. LumenDesk records the approval and the time it was submitted. For a signed contract, use your separate e-signature workflow.
